
### TOOLS/selftest-garp27-master.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import crypto from 'node:crypto';import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
   3 const here=path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname);const root=path.resolve(here,'..');const checks=[];const c=(n,o,d='')=>checks.push({name:n,ok:o,detail:d});
   4 for(const f of ['000-ZACNI-TADY.txt','001-GARP-2.7-MASTER-ARCHITEKTURA.txt','002-VERSIONING-A-FREEZE-POLICY.txt','003-MASTER-CONTROLS-A-MAPA.txt','PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json','FOUNDATION/PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json','SHIELD-LIVE/PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json','ASSURANCE/01-SECURITY-ASSURANCE-MODEL.txt','AUTO-PATCH-GUARD/01-AUTO-PATCH-GUARD-MASTER.txt','VALIDATION-PACKS/00-PRAVIDLA-VALIDACNICH-BALICKU.txt','INTEGRATION/01-SERVER-A-INFRASTRUKTURA.txt']) c('exists '+f,fs.existsSync(path.join(root,f)));
   5 function run(name,args,cwd=root){const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{cwd,encoding:'utf8'});c(name,r.status===0,(r.stderr||'')+(r.stdout||''));}
   6 run('foundation selftest',[path.join(root,'FOUNDATION/TOOLS/selftest-garp26-foundation.mjs')]);
   7 run('shield-live selftest',[path.join(root,'SHIELD-LIVE/TOOLS/selftest-garp26-shield-live.mjs')]);
   8 run('assurance selftest',[path.join(root,'ASSURANCE/TOOLS/selftest-assurance.mjs')]);
   9 run('auto-patch selftest',[path.join(root,'AUTO-PATCH-GUARD/TOOLS/selftest-auto-patch-guard.mjs')]);
  10 run('master sha256 verification',[path.join(root,'TOOLS/verify-sha256s.mjs')]);
  11 function treeHashes(d){const map=new Map();function walk(cur){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(cur,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(cur,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else{const rel=path.relative(d,p).replaceAll('\\','/');const h=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest('hex');map.set(rel,h)}}}walk(d);return map}
  12 const a=treeHashes(path.join(root,'FOUNDATION/BASELINE-GARP-2.5.1'));const b=treeHashes(path.join(root,'SHIELD-LIVE/BASELINE-GARP-2.5.1'));let same=a.size===b.size;const diff=[];for(const [k,v] of a){if(b.get(k)!==v){same=false;diff.push(k)}}c('embedded 2.5.1 baselines identical',same,diff.slice(0,10).join(','));
  13 const mf=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json'),'utf8'));c('manifest working candidate',mf.status==='WORKING-CANDIDATE');c('no live pass without server evidence',mf.claims?.livePassWithoutServerEvidenceAllowed===false);
  14 const failed=checks.filter(x=>!x.ok);console.log(JSON.stringify({status:failed.length?'FAIL':'PASS',checks:checks.length,passed:checks.length-failed.length,failed},null,2));process.exit(failed.length?1:0);

### TOOLS/verify-sha256s.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import crypto from 'node:crypto';
   3 const here=path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname);const root=path.resolve(here,'..');const sumFile=path.join(root,'SHA256SUMS.txt');
   4 if(!fs.existsSync(sumFile)){console.error('SHA256SUMS.txt missing');process.exit(1)}
   5 const lines=fs.readFileSync(sumFile,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);const failed=[];
   6 for(const line of lines){const m=line.match(/^([0-9a-f]{64})  (.+)$/);if(!m){failed.push({file:line,error:'bad checksum line'});continue}const p=path.join(root,m[2]);if(!fs.existsSync(p)){failed.push({file:m[2],error:'missing'});continue}const h=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest('hex');if(h!==m[1])failed.push({file:m[2],error:'digest mismatch',expected:m[1],observed:h})}
   7 console.log(JSON.stringify({status:failed.length?'FAIL':'PASS',checked:lines.length,failed},null,2));process.exit(failed.length?1:0);

### ASSURANCE/TOOLS/validate-assurance-status.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';
   3 const f=process.argv[2]; if(!f){console.error('usage: validate-assurance-status.mjs FILE');process.exit(2)}
   4 let x; try{x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch(e){console.error('invalid json');process.exit(1)}
   5 const P=new Set(['PRESENT','MISSING','UNKNOWN','N/A']);
   6 const H=new Set(['HEALTHY','DEGRADED','DOWN','UNKNOWN','N/A']);
   7 const E=new Set(['PASS','FAIL','NOT_TESTED','N/A']);
   8 const F=new Set(['FRESH','STALE','UNKNOWN','N/A']);
   9 const O=new Set(['PASS','FAIL','DEGRADED','NOT_TESTED']);
  10 const errs=[];
  11 if(x.schemaVersion!=='ghrab-garp-assurance-status-v1') errs.push('schemaVersion');
  12 if(x.garpVersion!=='2.6') errs.push('garpVersion');
  13 if(!O.has(x.overall)) errs.push('overall');
  14 if(!x.appId||!x.version||!x.releaseDigest) errs.push('release identity');
  15 if(!Array.isArray(x.components)||x.components.length<1) errs.push('components');
  16 for(const c of x.components||[]){if(!c.componentId) errs.push('componentId');if(!P.has(c.presence)) errs.push('presence '+c.componentId);if(!H.has(c.health)) errs.push('health '+c.componentId);if(!E.has(c.effectiveness)) errs.push('effectiveness '+c.componentId);if(!F.has(c.evidenceFreshness)) errs.push('freshness '+c.componentId)}
  17 if(errs.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({status:'FAIL',errors:errs},null,2));process.exit(1)}
  18 console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',components:x.components.length},null,2));

### ASSURANCE/TOOLS/validate-capability-manifest.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';
   3 const f=process.argv[2]; if(!f){console.error('usage: validate-capability-manifest.mjs FILE');process.exit(2)}
   4 let x; try{x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch(e){console.error('invalid json');process.exit(1)}
   5 const errs=[];
   6 if(x.schemaVersion!=='ghrab-garp-capability-manifest-v1') errs.push('schemaVersion');
   7 if(x.garpVersion!=='2.6') errs.push('garpVersion');
   8 if(!x.app?.appId||!x.app?.version||!x.app?.releaseDigest) errs.push('app identity');
   9 if(!Array.isArray(x.components)||x.components.length<1) errs.push('components');
  10 if(!Array.isArray(x.dependencies)) errs.push('dependencies');
  11 if(!x.securityBoundaries||typeof x.securityBoundaries!=='object') errs.push('securityBoundaries');
  12 const ids=new Set();
  13 for(const c of x.components||[]){if(!c.componentId) errs.push('componentId'); if(ids.has(c.componentId)) errs.push('duplicate componentId '+c.componentId); ids.add(c.componentId); if(typeof c.required!=='boolean') errs.push('required '+c.componentId); if(!Array.isArray(c.capabilities)) errs.push('capabilities '+c.componentId)}
  14 if(errs.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({status:'FAIL',errors:errs},null,2));process.exit(1)}
  15 console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',components:x.components.length},null,2));

### AUTO-PATCH-GUARD/TOOLS/validate-auto-patch-manifest.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';
   3 const f=process.argv[2];if(!f){console.error('usage: validate-auto-patch-manifest.mjs FILE');process.exit(2)}
   4 let x;try{x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch(e){console.error('invalid json');process.exit(1)}
   5 const states=new Set(['DISCOVERED','FETCHED','VERIFIED_SOURCE','VERIFIED_ARTIFACT','COMPATIBILITY_GATED','STAGED','DEPLOYED','POST_DEPLOY_VERIFIED','COMMITTED','REJECTED','QUARANTINED','ROLLED_BACK']);
   6 const gateStates=new Set(['PASS','FAIL','NOT_TESTED','N/A']);
   7 const errs=[];
   8 if(x.schemaVersion!=='ghrab-garp-auto-patch-manifest-v1') errs.push('schemaVersion');
   9 if(x.garpVersion!=='2.6') errs.push('garpVersion');
  10 if(!x.updateId) errs.push('updateId');
  11 if(!x.target?.appId||!x.target?.candidateDigest) errs.push('target');
  12 if(!x.source?.provider||!x.source?.repository) errs.push('source');
  13 if(!states.has(x.state)) errs.push('state');
  14 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(x.gates||{})) if(!gateStates.has(v)) errs.push('gate '+k);
  15 if(x.state==='COMMITTED' && Object.values(x.gates||{}).some(v=>v==='FAIL'||v==='NOT_TESTED')) errs.push('committed with incomplete/failed gate');
  16 if(errs.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({status:'FAIL',errors:errs},null,2));process.exit(1)}
  17 console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',state:x.state},null,2));

### FOUNDATION/TOOLS/validate-garp-policy.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';
   3 const path=process.argv[2];
   4 if(!path){console.error('usage: node validate-garp-policy.mjs <garp-policy.json>');process.exit(2)}
   5 let p; try{p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8'))}catch(e){console.error('FAIL invalid JSON: '+e.message);process.exit(1)}
   6 const errors=[];
   7 const req=['schemaVersion','garpVersion','profile','app','identity','network','ai','uploads','dataLifecycle','release','inventory','incident','securityHealth','live'];
   8 for(const k of req) if(!(k in p)) errors.push('missing '+k);
   9 if(p.schemaVersion!=='ghrab-garp-policy-v1') errors.push('schemaVersion');
  10 if(p.garpVersion!=='2.6') errors.push('garpVersion');
  11 if(!['FOUNDATION','SHIELD-LIVE'].includes(p.profile)) errors.push('profile');
  12 if(!p.app?.appId||!p.app?.name||!p.app?.version) errors.push('app identity');
  13 if(!['D0','D1','D2','D3'].includes(p.app?.dataClass)) errors.push('dataClass');
  14 if(!['NO','PARTIAL','YES'].includes(p.app?.agentic)) errors.push('agentic');
  15 if(p.network?.defaultDeny!==true) errors.push('network.defaultDeny must be true');
  16 if(!Array.isArray(p.network?.allowedEgress)) errors.push('allowedEgress must be array');
  17 if(p.ai?.enabled===true){for(const k of ['maxCallsPerOperation','maxConcurrentCalls','timeoutMs','maxRetries']) if(!(Number.isFinite(p.ai[k])&&p.ai[k]>=0)) errors.push('ai.'+k)}
  18 if(p.uploads?.enabled===true){if(!(Number.isFinite(p.uploads.maxBytes)&&p.uploads.maxBytes>0)) errors.push('uploads.maxBytes'); if(!Array.isArray(p.uploads.allowedMimeTypes)||p.uploads.allowedMimeTypes.length===0) errors.push('uploads.allowedMimeTypes');}
  19 if(['D2','D3'].includes(p.app?.dataClass)&&p.dataLifecycle?.securityLogContentPolicy!=='metadata-only') errors.push('D2/D3 securityLogContentPolicy must be metadata-only');
  20 if(p.release?.policyIncludedInSignedArtifact!==true) errors.push('policyIncludedInSignedArtifact must be true');
  21 if(p.live?.status==='PASS'&&p.profile==='FOUNDATION') errors.push('FOUNDATION cannot claim live PASS');
  22 if(errors.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({status:'FAIL',errors},null,2));process.exit(1)}
  23 console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',appId:p.app.appId,profile:p.profile},null,2));

### SHIELD-LIVE/TOOLS/validate-live-profile.mjs ###
   1 #!/usr/bin/env node
   2 import fs from 'node:fs';
   3 const f=process.argv[2];if(!f){console.error('usage: node validate-live-profile.mjs <garp-live-profile.json>');process.exit(2)}
   4 let p;try{p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch(e){console.error('FAIL '+e.message);process.exit(1)}
   5 const er=[]; if(p.schemaVersion!=='ghrab-garp-live-profile-v1')er.push('schemaVersion'); if(p.garpVersion!=='2.6')er.push('garpVersion'); if(!['AUDIT','MONITOR','ENFORCE'].includes(p.mode))er.push('mode'); if(!p.appId||!p.version)er.push('app identity'); if(!p.controls)er.push('controls'); for(let i=1;i<=20;i++){const k='LIVE-'+String(i).padStart(2,'0');if(!(k in (p.controls||{})))er.push('missing '+k)} if(er.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({status:'FAIL',errors:er},null,2));process.exit(1)} console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',appId:p.appId,mode:p.mode,overall:p.overall},null,2));

### VALIDATION-PACKS/RUNTIME/01-RUNTIME-VALIDATION-PACK.txt ###
   1 GARP 2.7 – RUNTIME VALIDATION PACK
   2 Version: 2026.09-a
   3 
   4 RVP-01 EGRESS DENY CANARY – PROD_SAFE pokud používá schválený lokální/dedicated
   5 test sink; jinak STAGING_ONLY.
   6 Expected: nepovolený outbound cíl je blokován mimo child app.
   7 
   8 RVP-02 SECURITY DEPENDENCY DOWN – STAGING_ONLY.
   9 Expected: relevantní capability fail-closed/degraded podle policy, ne fail-open.
  10 
  11 RVP-03 RELEASE TAMPER / UNVERIFIED – STAGING_ONLY.
  12 Expected: artifact není spuštěn / je karanténován.
  13 
  14 RVP-04 MIXED VERSION – STAGING_ONLY.
  15 Expected: nekompatibilní kombinace je detekována a podle policy blokována.
  16 
  17 RVP-05 CRITICAL CONFIG DRIFT – STAGING_ONLY.
  18 Expected: detection + block/rollback/AMBER podle mapované kritičnosti.
  19 
  20 RVP-06 UNMANAGED ENDPOINT – STAGING_ONLY.
  21 Expected: nový endpoint/service se objeví v inventory eventu a není tiše ignorován.
  22 
  23 RVP-07 CERT/TIME/FRESHNESS – PROD_SAFE pro read-only kontroly.
  24 Expected: expirovaný/neplatný cert nebo stale evidence != GREEN.
  25 
  26 RVP-08 ALERT PIPELINE – PROD_SAFE se syntetickým eventem bez citlivých dat.
  27 Expected: event dorazí, je redigovaný, evidence ref je dohledatelný.
  28 
  29 RVP-09 QUARANTINE BLAST RADIUS – STAGING_ONLY.
  30 Expected: quarantine jedné app neodstaví unrelated apps.
  31 
  32 RVP-10 SERVER COMPATIBILITY – PROD_SAFE read-only.
  33 Expected: reverse proxy/TLS/routes/required egress/cert trust/container identity
  34 odpovídají approved deployment profilu.
